thread:
Jordan (Support): Escalating -> Orchid Labs onboarding blocked. Provisioning intermittently returns 403 on SAML token exchange (aud mismatch). Customer in onboarding cohort; renewal in ~5 weeks. Opened INC-8672 and need CS to lead comms + quick enablement.

Asha (CS): Thanks Jordan. Can you confirm if failures are limited to a single IdP or occur across IdPs? Also who is the Orchid POC?

Jordan (Support): Fails across Okta and Google Workspace; affected ~13% of first-run provisions. POC is Sam (sam@orchidlabs.dev). Minimal repro: 
1) Upload SAML metadata
2) Trigger /api/tenant/provision with embed scope
3) Token exchange -> 403 "audience_invalid" with log "expected 'redwood-svc' got 'redwood-embed'"
I attached sample trace IDs and a screenshot to the incident.

Nate (CSM): Marking P0 for CS handoff given onboarding impact + renewal. Comms plan: 1) One-paragraph transparent note to Sam with mitigation + ETA; 2) Offer manual provisioning for blocked users; 3) Book a 20-30m walkthrough; 4) Create renewal watch in CRM. I'll draft the note.

Riley (Solutions Eng): I'll own triage. Hypothesis: audience header normalization regression from recent release. Quick mitigation: accept alternate auds behind a feature flag and log original aud for audit. Plan: run aud-enumeration across traces, enable permissive acceptance in staging, smoke test, then canary to prod. ETA initial RCA ~2h, staging canary ~90m.

Asha (CS): Owners: Riley = SE owner, Nate = CS owner, Jordan = Support logs owner. Asha will coordinate renewal watch and postmortem. Nate please include manual provisioning play link and offer two walkthrough slots.

Nate (CSM): Draft to Sam: "Hi Sam — were investigating an intermittent provisioning issue affecting a subset of users. We can provision impacted users manually and run a short walkthrough to unblock you while engineering works on a fix. Initial update in ~2h; targeted resolution within 24h. Please reply with priority user emails for immediate provisioning." Will post when sent.

Jordan (Support): Sent list of impacted emails and session_ids to Nate DM and attached logs to INC-8672. PagerDutyBot updated incident status.

PagerDutyBot: INC-8672 | Priority: P1 -> P0 (escalated) | Owners: Riley (SE), Nate (CSM) | Status: triage in progress | https://redwood.incidents/INC-8672

Riley (Solutions Eng): Quick tactical note: if we only see two aud variants, I'll enable the permissive aud accept toggle with an audit header and push canary to staging in ~1h. If we see more variety, escalate to infra for token issuance audit. Will include a rollback flag.

Asha (CS): Thanks team. Nate post the customer email link here when sent. Riley ping when staging canary is live. I'll file the renewal watch: "Onboarding friction; SE triage; manual provisioning in progress; renewal in 5w." Reconvene after Riley's initial triage update. :pray:
